page.title: 伝達動詞の型と疑問文レポート

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、伝達動詞が聞き手をどの形で取るかを整理し、tell・inform・remind・assureのように人を直接置く型、promise・askのように受け手を必要に応じて置く型、say to・explain to・complain to・agree withのように前置詞で相手を加える型を扱う。さらにyes/no疑問をif・whether節へ、wh疑問をwh語＋平叙文語順へ変え、do/does/didと疑問文倒置を消す。提案はsuggest＋-ingまたはsuggest that＋主語＋動詞原形で報告する。
grammarPoints: tell・inform・remind・assureは動詞＋人＋that節の形で受け手を直接置く
sayはsay to＋人、explain・complainはto＋人、agreeはwith＋人・意見で受け手や相手を示す
promise・askは文脈に応じて人を置くことも省くこともできる
yes/no疑問の報告はask＋人＋if／whether＋主語＋動詞で作る
wh疑問の報告はwh語を残し、疑問文倒置とdo-supportをやめて平叙文語順に戻す
suggestはsuggest＋動名詞、またはsuggest that＋主語＋動詞原形を取り、suggest＋人＋to不定詞とはしない
visualEvidence: 受け手が必須・任意・前置詞経由の三つのメッセージ経路
say meとexplain meに×、tell meとexplain to meに✓を付けた警告カード
疑問符が変換機を通りif／whether＋平叙文語順へ変わる図
wh語を先頭に残しながら主語と動詞の倒置がほどけるレール
Let'sの提案がsuggest＋-ing／that＋原形へ分岐する例
commonTraps: say me・explain meのように人を直接目的語に置く
tell to meのようにtellと不要なtoを組み合わせる
間接疑問内でwhere is the deskやwhether did heのように疑問文語順を残す
間接疑問内でdo・does・didを残したまま本動詞も変化させる
suggest to doやsuggest＋人＋to不定詞を使う
complain with、agree to a personなど、相手を導く前置詞を混同する

questions.prompt: The supervisor ------- the new employees that the west entrance was closed.

choices.A: told
choices.B: said
choices.C: explained
choices.D: complained

questions.translationJa: 上司は新入社員たちに、西側入口は閉鎖されていると伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: tellはtell＋人＋that節の型を取り、the new employeesを直接目的語にできます。

questions.prompt: The technician explained ------- the customer why the screen had gone blank.

choices.A: with
choices.B: at
choices.C: to
choices.D: by

questions.translationJa: 技術者は顧客に、画面が消えた理由を説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: explainは人を直接目的語にできないため、explain to＋人＋内容とします。

questions.prompt: The auditor asked ------- the receipts had been filed in date order.

choices.A: that
choices.B: whether
choices.C: what did
choices.D: why were

questions.translationJa: 監査担当者は、領収書が日付順に保管されているか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no疑問を報告するのでwhetherを用い、その後は平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Park asked where the spare keys -------.

choices.A: did keep
choices.B: were they kept
choices.C: keeping
choices.D: were kept

questions.translationJa: パークさんは予備鍵がどこに保管されているか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問ではwhereの後を主語the spare keys＋動詞were keptの平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: The human-resources officer ------- staff that annual declarations were due Friday.

choices.A: said
choices.B: explained to without a person
choices.C: reminded
choices.D: agreed

questions.translationJa: 人事担当者は社員に、年次申告書の締切が金曜日であることを念押ししました。
questions.explanationJa: remindはremind＋人＋that節の型で、忘れないよう情報を再提示します。

questions.prompt: The account manager ------- the client that the data would remain confidential.

choices.A: assured
choices.B: complained
choices.C: said to without content
choices.D: agreed with a promise

questions.translationJa: 担当営業は顧客に、データは秘密に保たれると保証しました。
questions.explanationJa: assure＋人＋that節で、相手の不安を取り除く保証を表します。

questions.prompt: The receptionist asked me ------- I needed a printed visitor badge.

choices.A: that
choices.B: did
choices.C: what
choices.D: if

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は私に、印刷した来訪者バッジが必要か尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no質問を報告するためifを用い、その後はI neededの平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Because two speakers were delayed, the organizer suggested ------- the panel until 2:00.

choices.A: to postpone us
choices.B: postponing
choices.C: that postponed
choices.D: postpone to

questions.translationJa: 講演者2名が遅れたため、主催者はパネル討論を2時まで延期することを提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: suggestはsuggest＋動名詞を取れるためpostponingが適切です。suggest to doとはしません。

questions.prompt: The procurement director agreed ------- the legal team's interpretation of the clause.

choices.A: with
choices.B: to a person opinion
choices.C: at
choices.D: for

questions.translationJa: 調達部長は、その条項についての法務チームの解釈に同意しました。
questions.explanationJa: 人・意見への同意はagree with＋人・見解で表します。

questions.prompt: The vendor promised us that it ------- the missing components by express delivery.

choices.A: will sent
choices.B: sending
choices.C: would send
choices.D: has send

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は、不足部品を速達で送ると私たちに約束しました。
questions.explanationJa: promiseは受け手usを置いても置かなくてもthat節を続けられ、過去のpromisedから見た未来はwould sendです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using tell.

choices.A: The coordinator told that attendees the room had changed.
choices.B: The coordinator said attendees that the room had changed.
choices.C: The coordinator told to attendees that had the room changed.
choices.D: The coordinator told attendees that the room had changed.

questions.translationJa: 調整担当者は参加者に、部屋が変更されたと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: tell＋人＋that節の順序が正しく、内容節も平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using explain.

choices.A: The agent explained us how would the refund be processed.
choices.B: The agent explained to us how the refund would be processed.
choices.C: The agent explained to us how would be processed the refund.
choices.D: The agent explained us that how the refund would process.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は私たちに、返金がどのように処理されるか説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: explain to＋人を用い、how節内はthe refund would be processedの平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct reported yes/no question.

choices.A: The inspector asked whether had the alarm been tested.
choices.B: The inspector asked did the alarm have been tested.
choices.C: The inspector asked whether the alarm had been tested.
choices.D: The inspector asked that the alarm had been tested?

questions.translationJa: 検査員は、警報装置が試験済みか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no疑問はwhetherで導き、内部はthe alarm had been testedの平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct reported wh-question.

choices.A: The manager asked why the shipment was late.
choices.B: The manager asked why was the shipment late.
choices.C: The manager asked why did the shipment arrive late.
choices.D: The manager asked that why the shipment was late.

questions.translationJa: 部長は、出荷がなぜ遅れたのか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問ではwhyを残し、主語the shipmentの後に動詞wasを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using assure.

choices.A: The hotel assured that guests the elevators were safe.
choices.B: The hotel assured guests that the elevators were safe.
choices.C: The hotel said guests that the elevators were safe.
choices.D: The hotel assured to guests were the elevators safe.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは宿泊客に、エレベーターは安全だと保証しました。
questions.explanationJa: assure＋人＋that節が正しい型です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a suggestion.

choices.A: Ms. Reed suggested to hold the meeting online.
choices.B: Ms. Reed suggested us to hold the meeting online.
choices.C: Ms. Reed suggested that holding the meeting online was we.
choices.D: Ms. Reed suggested holding the meeting online.

questions.translationJa: リードさんは会議をオンラインで行うことを提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: suggest＋動名詞が自然です。suggest to doやsuggest＋人＋toとはしません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a formal suggestion.

choices.A: The chair suggested that the committee review the proposal again.
choices.B: The chair suggested that the committee reviewed to the proposal again.
choices.C: The chair suggested the committee to review the proposal again.
choices.D: The chair suggested that did the committee review the proposal again.

questions.translationJa: 議長は委員会が提案を再度検討するよう提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: suggest that＋主語＋動詞原形reviewの形が正式な提案表現として正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence distinguishing say from tell.

choices.A: The director said me that the contract was ready.
choices.B: The director told to me that the contract was ready.
choices.C: The director said to me that the contract was ready.
choices.D: The director said me was the contract ready.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は私に、契約書の準備ができたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: sayで受け手を示す場合はsay to meとします。tellならtoを付けずtold meです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a question without do-support.

choices.A: The customer asked when would the replacement arrive.
choices.B: The customer asked when the replacement would arrive.
choices.C: The customer asked when did the replacement would arrive.
choices.D: The customer asked when does the replacement arrive yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は交換品がいつ到着するか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問では疑問文倒置やdo-supportを使わず、the replacement would arriveとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using complain to.

choices.A: Several tenants complained the manager that the hallway lights were off.
choices.B: Several tenants complained with the manager were the lights off.
choices.C: Several tenants told to the manager that the hallway lights off.
choices.D: Several tenants complained to the manager that the hallway lights were off.

questions.translationJa: 数名の入居者は管理者に、廊下の照明が消えていると苦情を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 苦情の相手はcomplain to＋人で示し、その後にthat節を続けられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Did you receive the revised invoice?” the clerk asked me.

choices.A: The clerk told me to revise the invoice.
choices.B: The clerk asked me whether I had received the revised invoice.
choices.C: The clerk asked why the invoice had been sent.
choices.D: The clerk assured me that no invoice existed.

questions.translationJa: 係員は私に、改訂請求書を受け取ったか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no質問をwhetherで導き、did receiveをhad receivedへ報告しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Where is the service desk?” the visitor asked.

choices.A: The visitor told the service desk where to move.
choices.B: The visitor asked whether the desk provided service.
choices.C: The visitor explained where he had bought a desk.
choices.D: The visitor asked where the service desk was.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者はサービスカウンターがどこにあるか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: whereを残し、is the service deskの倒置をthe service desk wasへ戻します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please remember that your badge expires Friday,” the officer said.

choices.A: The officer reminded me that my badge would expire Friday.
choices.B: The officer promised to renew every badge Friday.
choices.C: The officer asked whether Friday had expired.
choices.D: The officer complained that I wore a badge.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は、私のバッジが金曜日に期限切れになることを念押ししました。
questions.explanationJa: 忘れないように再提示する発言なのでreminded＋人＋that節が同じ機能を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Your information will not be shared,” the agent told the customer.

choices.A: The agent asked the customer to share the information.
choices.B: The agent complained that the customer had no information.
choices.C: The agent assured the customer that the information would remain private.
choices.D: The agent reminded the information to contact the customer.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は顧客に、その情報は非公開のままだと保証しました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手を安心させる内容なのでassured＋人＋that節が自然です。
questions.focus: tellからassureへの機能的言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Let's postpone the product demonstration,” Ms. Liu said.

choices.A: Ms. Liu promised that the demonstration had ended.
choices.B: Ms. Liu asked who had demonstrated the product.
choices.C: Ms. Liu assured us that postponement was impossible.
choices.D: Ms. Liu suggested postponing the product demonstration.

questions.translationJa: リウさんは製品実演を延期することを提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: Let'sによる提案はsuggested＋動名詞で自然に報告できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The charger stopped because the cable was loose,” the technician said to us.

choices.A: The technician told the charger to loosen the cable.
choices.B: The technician explained to us that a loose cable had caused the charger to stop.
choices.C: The technician asked whether we had bought a charger.
choices.D: The technician complained to the cable about the charger.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は私たちに、緩んだケーブルが充電器の停止原因だったと説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: said to usの説明機能をexplained to usで表し、原因関係を保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Do not worry; the reservation is confirmed,” the hotel told us.

choices.A: The hotel asked us whether we wanted to cancel.
choices.B: The hotel complained that we had no reservation.
choices.C: The hotel assured us that the reservation was confirmed.
choices.D: The hotel reminded the reservation to worry.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは私たちに、予約は確定していると保証しました。
questions.explanationJa: 不安を取り除く発言なのでassured us thatが最も近い意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “What time does the store open?” Elena asked.

choices.A: Elena asked what time the store opened.
choices.B: Elena asked what time did the store open.
choices.C: Elena told the store what time to open it.
choices.D: Elena promised that the store would close.

questions.translationJa: エレナは店が何時に開店するか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問ではdoesを消し、what time＋the store openedの語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I will send the certificate,” the trainer said.

choices.A: The trainer asked whether the certificate had arrived.
choices.B: The trainer denied that any certificate existed.
choices.C: The trainer said that the certificate would be sent.
choices.D: The trainer ordered the recipient to create a certificate.

questions.translationJa: 講師は、証明書は送付されると述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 直接発言の将来内容をwould be sentで間接話法にし、証明書が送られるという意味を保っています。
questions.focus: 直接話法の未来内容の報告

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I think the legal team is right,” the director said.

choices.A: The director explained the legal team to be absent.
choices.B: The director agreed with the legal team's view.
choices.C: The director asked whether the team had a right.
choices.D: The director complained to the team about every law.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は法務チームの見解に同意しました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手の見解が正しいと認める内容をagreed with＋見解で簡潔に表しています。

questions.prompt: The delivery status was unclear. The agent asked the carrier ------- the parcel had left the depot.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: that
choices.C: what did
choices.D: where was

questions.translationJa: 配送状況が不明でした。担当者は運送会社に、荷物が配送所を出たか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/noで答えられる内容なのでwhetherを使い、後ろは平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: A visitor could not find the elevator. She asked where it -------.

choices.A: was it
choices.B: did be
choices.C: does
choices.D: was

questions.translationJa: 来訪者はエレベーターを見つけられませんでした。どこにあるか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問ではwhere＋主語it＋動詞wasの語順にします。

questions.prompt: The support agent wanted to prevent the customer from forgetting the deadline. She ------- him that the form was due at noon.

choices.A: said
choices.B: reminded
choices.C: explained without to
choices.D: agreed

questions.translationJa: サポート担当者は顧客が締切を忘れないようにしたいと考えました。書類は正午締切だと念押ししました。
questions.explanationJa: 忘れないよう再提示する目的にはreminded＋人＋that節が適切です。

questions.prompt: Customers were worried about a data breach. The company ------- them that no payment details had been exposed.

choices.A: complained to
choices.B: asked if
choices.C: assured
choices.D: said without a listener

questions.translationJa: 顧客は情報漏えいを心配していました。会社は決済情報は流出していないと保証しました。
questions.explanationJa: 不安を解消する文脈なのでassured them thatが最適です。

questions.prompt: The meeting room was unavailable, so Mr. Shah proposed an alternative. He suggested ------- by video instead.

choices.A: meeting
choices.B: to meet us
choices.C: that met
choices.D: meet to

questions.translationJa: 会議室が利用できなかったため、シャーさんは代案を出しました。代わりにビデオで会議することを提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: suggestの後に動名詞meetingを置いて提案内容を表します。

questions.prompt: The customer wanted a detailed reason for the charge. The representative explained ------- her how the fee had been calculated.

choices.A: at
choices.B: with
choices.C: from
choices.D: to

questions.translationJa: 顧客は請求の詳しい理由を求めました。担当者は料金の計算方法を彼女に説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: explainは人を直接目的語にできないためto herが必要です。

questions.prompt: The supervisor needed a simple yes-or-no answer. He asked me ------- I could work Saturday.

choices.A: why did
choices.B: that
choices.C: if
choices.D: what was

questions.translationJa: 上司は単純な可否の回答を必要としていました。私に土曜日に勤務できるか尋ねました。
questions.explanationJa: yes/no質問なのでifを用い、後ろはI could workの平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: “Why was the invoice rejected?” the buyer asked. In the minutes, this became: the buyer asked why the invoice -------.

choices.A: had it been rejected
choices.B: had been rejected
choices.C: did reject
choices.D: was rejecting it by itself

questions.translationJa: 買い手は「なぜ請求書が却下されたのですか」と尋ねました。議事録では、請求書がなぜ却下されたのか尋ねたと記されました。
questions.explanationJa: 間接疑問では倒置を戻し、報告より前の受動をhad been rejectedで表します。
questions.focus: wh間接疑問と過去完了受動

questions.prompt: The tenants directed their dissatisfaction at the building manager. They complained ------- him that the heating had failed again.

choices.A: with agreement
choices.B: for
choices.C: by
choices.D: to

questions.translationJa: 入居者たちは建物管理者に不満を向けました。暖房がまた故障したと彼に苦情を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 苦情を伝える相手はcomplain to＋人で示します。

questions.prompt: The committee did not issue an order; it offered an idea for consideration. The chair therefore ------- that the launch be moved to May.

choices.A: suggested
choices.B: told the launch
choices.C: assured
choices.D: reminded the launch

questions.translationJa: 委員会は命令を出したのではなく、検討案を示しました。そのため議長は発売を5月へ移すことを提案しました。
questions.explanationJa: 提案の文脈なのでsuggested that＋主語＋原形beが適切です。
